title: Materials Today Conference 2027
about: Elsevier's Materials Today Conference 2027 takes place 18 to 22 July 2027 at Le Corum, Montpellier, France. It accepts talk and poster abstracts across six symposia; the abstract deadline is 5 February 2027, with author notification on 29 March 2027.
